Response fields include usage.completion_tokens, usage.prompt_tokens, usage.total_tokens, and usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens.

Input details include usage.prompt_tokens_details.text_tokens, usage.prompt_tokens_details.image_tokens, usage.prompt_tokens_details.video_tokens, and usage.prompt_tokens_details.audio_tokens. Output details include usage.completion_tokens_details.text_tokens, usage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens, and usage.completion_tokens_details.audio_tokens.

Explicit cache details include usage.prompt_tokens_details.cache_creation.cache_creation_input_tokens and usage.prompt_tokens_details.cache_creation.ephemeral_5m_input_tokens.

Set stream_options.include_usage to receive usage on the final streaming chunk.

Set enable_thinking to select thinking mode where the model supports it.
